# DIY awning leg mounting system

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Sleeve larger diameter PVC over smaller pole and pre-drill straight lines for long cut-to-fit screws. [t939]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Sleeve a larger piece of PVC over the smaller pole and pre-drill straight lines for screws.
2. Use long screws that bite into the PVC but are cut short so they don't protrude through the inside.
3. Thread these screws through the reinforced edge of the tarp every 2 inches along its length.

_Procedure reported by [t939]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Use guy lines and ground stakes to put tension on the awning. [t939]
- Consider using a wider tarp than the roof rack width, then adding wood strips for extra strap points. [t939]
